sources.title: GLiNER2.5-Decide: An Open-Weight Model for Structured Decision Making
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5-Decide is an encoder-based decision model post-trained specifically for structured decision-making. It evaluates user-defined typed questions and can decode related answers jointly under explicit constraints, returning structured decisions with probabilities, confidence scores, and feasibility metadata.
